prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium hand-painted deep-space environmental background for a 2D space shooter, landscape 1536x1024 pixels, full-bleed bitmap.
Style/medium: richly detailed cinematic science fiction concept painting, realistic materials, sophisticated atmospheric perspective, intricate fine cosmic dust and restrained tiny stars, art direction equal to a professional PC space game. Crisp natural surface textures, subtle painterly polish, immense scale.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape. The middle 60 percent and entire lower two thirds are predominantly very dark calm midnight navy negative space with only faint dust and sparse tiny pinprick stars, so luminous small gameplay ships and bullets stay extremely readable. Landmarks and luminous detail are concentrated in the upper third and outer perimeter. The quiet center must remain spacious, not crowded.
Lighting/mood: monumental, immersive, mysterious, exquisite dark cinematic lighting. No glaring white light, no large bright blobs anywhere in the central/lower playfield.
Text: none.
Constraints: This is one actual background painting, not a game screenshot or mockup. No spacecraft, fighters, vehicles, characters, actors, HUD, UI, text, lettering, logos, watermark, grid, foreground game objects, bullet-like streaks, enemy-like objects, diagram, comic panels, flat vector art. Entire image must look intentional and richly painted, never plain flat black.
Primary request: A distant enormous black-hole singularity in the upper-right quadrant, occupying about 28 percent of this wide composition. Its dark round event horizon is surrounded by an elegant slender emerald and jade accretion ring, realistically tilted in perspective, with an exquisite gravitationally bent green light arc around the upper silhouette. The ring is delicate, moderately luminous green, not glaring white or a broad saturated blob. Keep the landmark completely within the upper-right top third as much as possible, with only a subtle curved edge reaching downward at the far right. Soft rich green gas and tiny jade dust particles appear at the far outer edges and top, while the dark navy center/lower field stays open and serene. Distant pinprick stars, convincing scale and depth, textured faint wisps around the void.
Color palette: black-blue midnight navy, extremely dark forest green, restrained luminous jade and emerald, cool teal depth. No cyan-white flare, no orange, no bright green wash across the center.
description: Jade and emerald singularity in the upper right with a slender bent accretion ring and a calm midnight-navy playfield.
visual_validation: Inspected generated image: no text, HUD, ships, or bright central clumps; prominent landmark remains near upper/peripheral area and central/lower playfield is quiet.
